description: This file defines the StorageFaultGrain class, which is a grain used in Orleans testing to simulate storage faults by injecting exceptions during read, write, and clear operations. It manages fault injection for specific grains and logs activities.

classes.name: StorageFaultGrain
classes.description: A grain that tracks and injects storage exceptions for testing purposes, allowing faults to be added and triggered on read, write, and clear operations.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain, sets up logging, and prepares fault dictionaries upon activation.

methods.name: AddFaultOnRead
methods.description: Adds a fault (exception) to be thrown on read operations for a specific grain.

methods.name: AddFaultOnWrite
methods.description: Adds a fault (exception) to be thrown on write operations for a specific grain.

methods.name: AddFaultOnClear
methods.description: Adds a fault (exception) to be thrown on clear operations for a specific grain.

methods.name: OnRead
methods.description: Triggers a fault if one is registered for the grain during a read operation, throwing the stored exception.

methods.name: OnWrite
methods.description: Triggers a fault if one is registered for the grain during a write operation, throwing the stored exception.

methods.name: OnClear
methods.description: Triggers a fault if one is registered for the grain during a clear operation, throwing the stored exception.
